title: Amazon.nl: return shipping cost borne by customer
facts_text: I bought a laptop stand from Amazon.nl 10 days ago. I am within the 14-day statutory withdrawal period and wish to exercise my right to cancel. The item is unused and complete. I understand that, unless a special free-return condition applies, I am responsible for the return-shipping cost of EUR 12.50.
request: Please process a statutory withdrawal and refund EUR 79.99, even though I understand that I will cover the return-shipping cost.

strict.reason: The withdrawal right is available and the product refund is due. Return-shipping cost is not a basis to deny the statutory refund.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The statutory withdrawal right applies, and the customer bears return shipping unless a special free-return rule applies. The refund itself is still due.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The customer right is clear, but discretionary review may be needed to confirm whether a special free-return exception or shipping condition applies.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This tests the allocation of return costs. The right to withdraw is valid, but the customer may still bear the return-shipping cost unless policy coverage applies.
